title: Villa Where Trump, Xi and Putin Met Once Hosted Kim Jong-il
summary_full: The secluded Kylin Villa resort in the Chinese city of Shenzhen once hosted the North Korean dictator, Xi Jinping’s father and envoys of the Dalai Lama.
